fusions.name: Battering Run
fusions.desc: Sends a tightly curled ball of scales into the first enemy it meets, dealing 14 damage and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Drives a heavy blow along the ground that deals 9 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Column Discipline
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 15 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Paved Footing
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 10% and your armour by 8%.
